shots.narration_english: Malak's whole body seemed to freeze. Inside the file lay a handkerchief smeared with fresh blood! The blood on it still looked wet.

shots.narration_english: At the same moment a foul smell spread through the whole place. Her eyes wide, she flung the file from her hand. In fear she gasped.
